name: robots/machines-in-motion__go2py
title: Unitree Go2 (Go2Py GO2Real)
intro: Unitree Go2 (Go2Py GO2Real), adapted from machines-in-motion/go2py. It reads `joint_positions`, `joint_velocities`, `joint_torques`, `motor_temperatures` and 6 more; runs `stop_motion`, `drive` and `command_joints`. `stop_motion`: stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
